name: FreeInkFont
description: Standalone TTF/OTF font engine (outline rasterization, advances, kerning, ligatures, per-codepoint fallback) with arena-bounded, no-heap caching. Decoupled from any layout or book engine so any consumer can render real fonts.
keywords: font, ttf, otf, freetype, stb_truetype, glyph, eink, epaper, rasterizer
